workItem: Restore Self-Healing convergence by allowing exact CI workflow_dispatch revalidation runs to re-enter the existing bounded autofix and Decision/Evidence listeners.
rootCause: Two coupled orchestration defects stopped convergence: exact CI revalidation was redispatched as workflow_dispatch while downstream listeners accepted only pull_request, and the Decision/Evidence Reconciler treated a uniquely bounded but non-canonical v1.8 Live Dashboard as ambiguous instead of replacing that table atomically. PR #1218 exposed the second defect after Governance rejected its incomplete dashboard.
approvedScope: Modify only the existing canonical listeners/reconciler and regression tests; allow bounded replacement of exactly one table-only Live Dashboard immediately before the canonical Human Decision table; preserve single-writer ownership, exact PR/head/ref/current-main binding, allowlisted repairers, bounded attempts and Human/CODEOWNER merge authority.
exitEvidence: CI pull_request and exact CI workflow_dispatch failures both reach the canonical controller.
workflow_dispatch re-entry is restricted to exact CI path plus live PR head SHA/ref/current-main correlation.
Current-State and bounded CI repair specialists can continue after their own exact-head CI redispatch.
Decision/Evidence reconciliation observes exact dispatched CI completion.
A uniquely bounded table-only malformed v1.8 Live Dashboard is atomically replaced by the canonical Evidence-derived dashboard, while prose/duplicate/ambiguous boundaries remain fail-closed.
No second writer, branch-sync path, PR-body writer or merge authority is introduced.
Hosted workflow security/governance/tests pass on the exact PR head.
releaseCondition: Release when the associated Pull Request is merged, closed, superseded or abandoned.
